verdict.rationale: Fern documents that it automatically generates and maintains an llms.txt file for docs sites. A live probe confirms an HTTP 200 llms.txt with agent instructions on Fern's own published docs. Clean per-page Markdown via .md URLs and llms.txt traffic analytics add to the agent-indexing story. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of an llms-full.txt or other full-content variant (only per-page .md is documented), and independent corroboration on customer sites.
